summary: Frontend-only verification of two changes: (1) Biaya Channel default components order + Biaya Pesanan Rp/order behavior; (2) Tren Nilai Produk zeroing after full Reset Data. Both verified working end-to-end via the Expo web preview.

biaya_channel_default_components.types_visual: First 3 = %, Biaya Pesanan = Rp, PPh = %, Packaging = Rp (confirmed via screenshot; Rp/% pill highlighting matches)
biaya_channel_default_components.biaya_pesanan_type_toggle: Toggle between Rp and % works (verified by clicking cc-comp-type-3-percent and cc-comp-type-3-rp; UI highlight updates)
biaya_channel_default_components.add_component_button: cc-add-component adds a new empty row (verified: row index 6 appears after click)
biaya_channel_default_components.scope_controls: cc-scope-all and cc-scope-sku both present (Global / SKU Tertentu)
biaya_channel_default_components.basis_effective_date_status: Basis Perhitungan appears when % component present, Tanggal Berlaku (DateField) and Status (SelectField) render as expected

reset_and_tren_nilai_produk.code_review_of_calc_ts: stockOf now returns 0 when monthKey < firstStockMonth(data). firstStockMonth computes earliest month across purchases/adjustments/orders or falls back to latestMonthKey when no movements exist. After a full reset there are no movements, so firstStockMonth == latestMonthKey (=today month) and every trailing month before it is strictly less -> zeroed. Current/latest data month is >= firstStockMonth so it is NOT zeroed. Seed data (2025-10..2026-09) is unaffected because trailing 6 months from Sep '26 (Apr..Sep '26) are all >= earliest activity month.

critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: existing 'Require cycle: src/data/store.tsx -> src/hooks/useAnalyticsMonth.ts -> src/data/store.tsx' warning in console. Not caused by this change; consider refactoring the cycle in a future pass.
biaya-channel.tsx is a single-file 148-line module: fine for size, dense one-liners are readable enough; no refactor needed for this change.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded state, then exercised Reset Data (all modules) which is the specific flow under test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: State is client-side (AsyncStorage key bos.data.v2). After running these tests the app data was fully reset in the preview browser context; open in a fresh browser/incognito to see seeded data again. Key testIDs used: cc-comp-name-<i>, cc-comp-type-<i>-rp|percent, cc-comp-value-<i>, cc-add-component, cc-scope-all/sku, reset-select-all, reset-data-button, confirm-button, reset-data-done, tren-nilai-produk-card.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: stockOf treated openingStock as retroactive stock for all months, so months before the earliest activity month showed non-zero stock value even after Reset Data. Fix in src/data/calc.ts: stockOf returns 0 when monthKey < firstStockMonth(data); firstStockMonth = earliest month across purchases/adjustments/orders, falling back to latestMonthKey. This ensures a full reset yields firstStockMonth == current month, so all earlier trailing months = 0, while the latest month still uses openingStock + purchases + adjustments - sales for products that exist.
